# Town of Waterford municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 25; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Waterford, Selectboard page (waterfordvt.gov): lists the current five-member board -- Tim Yarrow (Chair), Wade Cochran, Shawn Hallisey, Kathleen Hodgdon, and Ron Gray. DIVERGENCE: the June 2026 Secretary of State directory lists William Jones (Vice Chair) as the fifth member and omits Gray; the town's live page governs currency (disclosed on #163). Hodgdon is also a Justice of the Peace; one record carries both memberships
Town of Waterford, Town Clerk page (waterfordvt.gov): styles her 'Deb Benoit'; the Secretary of State's Guide gives the full form
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Debra Benoit as Waterford's Town Clerk
Town of Waterford, Town Clerk page: names Heather M. Gonyaw as Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Heather Gonyaw as Waterford's Town Treasurer

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator; no published official source names Waterford's current moderator); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Waterford justices of the peace: Erin Dimick, Kristen Fessenden, Kevin Gillander, Kathleen Hodgdon, David Morrison, Miriam Simon, and Bernard Willey

Town of Waterford, Board of Civil Authority page: the board (Selectboard + the seven justices) concurs with the certified slate; it styles Willey 'Bernard Willey II' -- the certified form governs his name

jp_election.name: Town of Waterford Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the seven winners of Waterford's November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election (vote for seven): Erin Dimick, Kristen Fessenden, Kevin Gillander, Kathleen Hodgdon, David Morrison, Miriam Simon, and Bernard Willey. All seven remain in office
